checks.text: With no items the page shows the heading "Grocery List", the text "No items yet", and the progress line "0 of 0 done".

Typing "Milk" in the field labelled "Item name", typing "2" in the field labelled "Quantity", and clicking the button "Add item" adds a list item that contains "Milk" and "×2"; the progress line reads "0 of 1 done" and "No items yet" is gone.
After also adding "Bread" with Quantity "1", a list item contains "Bread" and "×1", and the progress line reads "0 of 2 done".
Clicking "Add item" with an empty "Item name" adds no list item and shows the message "Enter an item name".
Clicking the checkbox on the list item "Milk ×2" marks it done and the progress line reads "1 of 2 done"; clicking it again returns the progress line to "0 of 2 done".
Every list item has a button named "Delete <item name>". With items "Milk ×2" and "Bread ×1", clicking "Delete Bread" removes that item and the progress line reads "0 of 1 done".
Clicking the button "Copy list" copies the text "Milk ×2\nBread ×1" to the clipboard and shows the message "Copied to clipboard".
Clicking the button "Export CSV" downloads a file whose content is "name,quantity\nMilk,2\nBread,1".
Reload keeps the list: after adding "Milk" with Quantity "2" and checking it, reloading the page still shows the list item "Milk ×2" in its checked state and the progress line "1 of 1 done".
